tweet_pool.author: sama
tweet_pool.text: Good news: Sol is a smart, efficient step forward. Bad news: at the request of the US government, it launches today in limited preview instead of the open access launch we were planning.

tweet_pool.author: sama
tweet_pool.text: actually i think a required preview period for extended redteaming is not a bad idea. i just dont like the idea of the government picking the customers.

tweet_pool.author: AlexFinn
tweet_pool.text: Ornith-1.0 35b is the best local model I've run that doesn't require 200GB+ of RAM. Smarter and faster than Qwen 3.6 in my tests, runs well on a DGX Spark.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Practitioner hands-on with the smaller Ornith-1.0 35b local model, claiming it beats Qwen 3.6 on a DGX Spark. 181k views.

tweet_pool.author: GergelyOrosz
tweet_pool.text: GLM-5.2 plus the US banning the most capable new models means open source caught up to SOTA closed source coding models. Could be problematic for Anthropic and OpenAI revenue and IPO plans.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Sharp analytic take tying GLM-5.2 plus US frontier-model restrictions to a revenue/IPO risk for the closed labs. Credible practitioner voice, fresh (1h old).

tweet_pool.author: rileywestreel
tweet_pool.text: Amodei and Hassabis on when AGI lands: Amodei 1-2 years, Hassabis 5-10. Amodei: assume I'm right, why can't we slow down to Demis' timeline?
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete on-stage exchange contrasting Amodei (AGI 1-2 yrs) and Hassabis (5-10 yrs), Amodei arguing for slowing to the longer timeline. Notable framing of the timeline debate.

tweet_pool.author: AnatoliKopadze
tweet_pool.text: Anthropic CEO: there are jobs that took generations to build that may disappear. The economy splits into people who use AI and people who get displaced.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Widely shared clip of an Amodei interview on AI's labour-market split and jobs that may disappear. 262k views; complements the Econ Index data from a human-impact angle.

tweet_pool.author: jmrphy
tweet_pool.text: After a week with beta testers, I believe we have the ticket to solving slop in LLM output. It's a tiny 14b model fine-tuned with a specific technical innovation.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Practitioner claim of a fine-tuned 14b model targeting LLM slop after a week of beta testing. Concrete technical observation, healthy reply engagement.

tweet_pool.author: cryptorover
tweet_pool.text: Musk says AI demand is now so extreme that production shortages have become insane. Tim Cook says tech cost inflation is the worst he has seen in 40 years.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Strong-engagement item relaying Musk on AI-driven production shortages and Tim Cook on 40-year-high tech cost inflation. Macro/supply angle on the AI buildout. 330k views.
